# Tathastu Keepsakes — product facts for assistants

> Tathastu Keepsakes is an Agra-based 3D printing store for custom gifts and keepsakes. Diwali 2026 car dashboard God idols ship from ₹850 (sale). Made-to-order PLA/PLA+, PAN India delivery, free shipping over ₹199.

Site: https://www.tathastukeepsakes.in
Workshop: Agra, India
Material: PLA / PLA+ (FDM 3D print), made to order
Dispatch: 2–4 days · Free shipping over ₹199 · PAN India
Heat note: PLA softens ~55–60°C — keep dashboard idols out of direct sun in a parked car.
Diwali 2026: 8 November — order dashboard idols early for festival delivery.

## Quick answers

- What is a Tathastu dashboard idol? A compact 3D-printed PLA murti with a flat base for car dash, desk, or home mandir.
- Where are they made? Printed to order in Agra by [Tathastu Keepsakes](https://www.tathastukeepsakes.in/about).
- Lowest Diwali set price? Several idols at ₹850.
- Largest size? Lord Shiva on Nandi up to 8 Inch (sale ₹1150).
